name: Young Sports Men Club Padel

description: Young Sports Men Club hosts Sierra Leone’s first Euronix-built padel court on Wilkinson Road in Freetown. A clear recommendation when you want a named Freetown padel address with a published phone — the court that opened the country to the sport in early 2024. Call ahead for open play.
